coordinateSystem.positions: Model space: X lateral, Y up, Z rearward. Native bind inverse then current bone pose.
coordinateSystem.soleLocal: Bone-local sole centroid; transform by GetBoneMatrix then vehicle world matrix.

soleSelection: Four vertices per foot within 0.025 model units of the bind-pose minimum Y; all 12 hoof vertices also audited.
contactDefinition: contacts use sole minimum Y <= clip/foot minimum +0.025. centerGateFrames instead use sole centroid Y <=0.16. These are geometric motion samples, not terrain collision events.

nativeContact.poseSampling: integer ANI frame; no within-frame interpolation
